reason: 59 lari is nothing for me, but my guests are the business and Instagram and WhatsApp already fill my weekends for free. I might take the free listing, but I won't put a stranger's QR on my tables and hand my regulars to a startup I have never heard of.
objection: Will this company still be here in a year, and who owns my guest list? If they close or start selling my guests to the wine bar down the street, I lose what I built over years. Also, in a wine bar guests expect to pay through the waiter, not their phone.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that the guest data is mine and I can export all of it any time, plus two or three respected venues in Sololaki or Vake already using it happily.
